title.narrative: Hubei Xianning Low-Carbon and Climate-Resilient Urban Development Project

description.narrative: The project will enhance the livability, accessibility, and sustainability of Xianning City and Chibi City in Hubei Province by promoting an efficient, smart, safe, and resilient transportation system and urban services. It will enhance institutional capacity for resilient urban development through improved mechanisms for interagency coordination, flood modeling, transport demand management, road safety assessments, public awareness programs, and smart emergency response systems based on digital twin technology. The knowledge and insights gained from this project are designed to serve as a scalable model for urban development and management, applicable to other small cities.
